Steve Bannon on Israel:
We need to have an arm's-length relationship with Israel that is supportive, but like other allies, exactly like we do in NATO. You can't have this intertwining.
The younger generation, I'm telling you, under 40 years old, they're saying, "We want our sovereignty back. When decisions are made, we want to make sure that they're American citizens making decisions, even if those decisions are made by socialists or Muslim Brotherhood."

Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez:
There are so many criminals in this administration. It's hard to figure out who should be, you know, the order of operations. 
There are going to be many, many, many investigations, I imagine many subpoenas, and we have to follow wherever the evidence takes us.

Former U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry on Trump:
The current president, who makes those decisions, has so clearly defined himself as an aberration beyond any creative imagination.
I think most people know this is just not the norm. It's not what we're going to see in the future.
I don't think you're going to see one candidate on the Democratic side who looks, talks, feels, or thinks like the current president. 
And frankly, you won't find many on the Republican side either.

Trump has again ordered restrictions on companies suspected of diverting Nvidia AI chips to China, following consultations with Elon Musk and senior administration officials.
Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick reportedly opposed the move, warning it could trigger a trade war with China.
Despite Trump's approval, the restrictions have yet to be implemented.
Source: Axios

Former U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry:
Donald Trump came to office saying, "I want to be number one. We want America to be number one. We're going to beat China."
And he walked away from the battlefield. Ran away. He didn't do anything.
China has now constructed and deployed more renewables than all the rest of the world put together. Think about that. Just ceded the marketplace.
You want to buy panels? Go to China. You want to buy a really good electric car that has a charging network? Go to China.

Former U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry:
Even in Donald Trump's first term, 75% of the new electricity in the United States came from renewables.
Obviously, he didn't know that, so he didn't stop it.
But even now, with all of this incredible attitude towards offshore wind, which other countries are doing in huge amounts, he's railing against it and preventing it from happening here.
And even now, the percentage of renewables is 91%.
